```plato
    // The adjugate: the transpose of the cofactor matrix, so that
    // Adjugate * (1 / Determinant) is the inverse. Defined for every matrix,
    // singular or not. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adjugate_matrix
    Adjugate(self: Matrix4x4): Matrix4x4 {
        var m11 = self.Row1.X; var m12 = self.Row1.Y; var m13 = self.Row1.Z; var m14 = self.Row1.W;
        var m21 = self.Row2.X; var m22 = self.Row2.Y; var m23 = self.Row2.Z; var m24 = self.Row2.W;
        var m31 = self.Row3.X; var m32 = self.Row3.Y; var m33 = self.Row3.Z; var m34 = self.Row3.W;
        var m41 = self.Row4.X; var m42 = self.Row4.Y; var m43 = self.Row4.Z; var m44 = self.Row4.W;
        // The 2x2 minors of rows 3 and 4 ...
        var kpLo = m33 * m44 - m34 * m43;
        var jpLn = m32 * m44 - m34 * m42;
        var joKn = m32 * m43 - m33 * m42;
        var ipLm = m31 * m44 - m34 * m41;
        var ioKm = m31 * m43 - m33 * m41;
        var inJm = m31 * m42 - m32 * m41;
        // ... of rows 2 and 4 ...
        var gpHo = m23 * m44 - m24 * m43;
        var fpHn = m22 * m44 - m24 * m42;
        var foGn = m22 * m43 - m23 * m42;
        var epHm = m21 * m44 - m24 * m41;
        var eoGm = m21 * m43 - m23 * m41;
        var enFm = m21 * m42 - m22 * m41;
        // ... and of rows 2 and 3.
        var glHk = m23 * m34 - m24 * m33;
        var flHj = m22 * m34 - m24 * m32;
        var fkGj = m22 * m33 - m23 * m32;
        var elHi = m21 * m34 - m24 * m31;
        var ekGi = m21 * m33 - m23 * m31;
        var ejFi = m21 * m32 - m22 * m31;
        return (Number4(m22 * kpLo - m23 * jpLn + m24 * joKn,
                        -(m12 * kpLo - m13 * jpLn + m14 * joKn),
                        m12 * gpHo - m13 * fpHn + m14 * foGn,
                        -(m12 * glHk - m13 * flHj + m14 * fkGj)),
                Number4(-(m21 * kpLo - m23 * ipLm + m24 * ioKm),
                        m11 * kpLo - m13 * ipLm + m14 * ioKm,
                        -(m11 * gpHo - m13 * epHm + m14 * eoGm),
                        m11 * glHk - m13 * elHi + m14 * ekGi),
                Number4(m21 * jpLn - m22 * ipLm + m24 * inJm,
                        -(m11 * jpLn - m12 * ipLm + m14 * inJm),
                        m11 * fpHn - m12 * epHm + m14 * enFm,
                        -(m11 * flHj - m12 * elHi + m14 * ejFi)),
                Number4(-(m21 * joKn - m22 * ioKm + m23 * inJm),
                        m11 * joKn - m12 * ioKm + m13 * inJm,
                        -(m11 * foGn - m12 * eoGm + m13 * enFm),
                        m11 * fkGj - m12 * ekGi + m13 * ejFi));
    }
```
